name: model-router
description: Classify each prompt as easy/normal/hard, log token usage per step, and optionally adjust effort or model per tier

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: log: classify and log only, change nothing. route: apply the lever per tier.

lever.title: Lever
lever.description: both (recommended): model picked once per session from the first prompt, effort per prompt. effort: effort only. model: model only.

switchStyle.title: How the model is switched
switchStyle.description: visible: switch the session's model so /model and the footer show it; your saved setting is written back unchanged right away. silent: never touch the setting, send the model on each request. Sessions without a terminal UI always run silent.

easyEffort.title: Effort for easy prompts
easyEffort.description: Effort level sent for easy prompts.

hardEffort.title: Effort for hard prompts
hardEffort.description: Effort level sent for hard prompts.

easyModel.title: Model for easy prompts
easyModel.description: Model for a session whose first prompt is easy.

normalModel.title: Model for normal sessions
normalModel.description: Model for a session whose first prompt is normal; empty keeps your own model (as /config shows it).

hardModel.title: Model for hard prompts
hardModel.description: Model for hard prompts; empty keeps your own model (as /config shows it), e.g. opus[1m].

switchTurns.title: Turns the model may switch in
switchTurns.description: The session model follows each prompt only in its first N typed prompts; after that it is kept (a switch loses the prompt cache), except for escalation.

escalate.title: Escalate within a session
escalate.description: A session that started on a lighter model moves up when a later prompt is harder. It never moves down.

guideSubagents.title: Guide subagent model and effort
guideSubagents.description: route mode: send a short guide beside the session's first prompt so the main session picks each subagent's model and effort (search work on haiku/low, hard work on xhigh). Every Agent call is logged either way.
